**Word**
<!-- The word in question, all caps -->

**Issue type**
<!-- Select one -->
- [ ] Should be removed as an answer (too obscure, proper noun, plural, 3rd-person verb form, etc.)
- [ ] Should be added as an answer (common word currently missing)
- [ ] Should be added as a valid guess only (recognised word but too obscure to be an answer)

**Reason**
<!-- Why should this word be added or removed? Be specific. -->

**Word list**
<!-- Which word list(s) does this affect? -->
- [ ] American English
- [ ] British English
- [ ] Both
